pretreatment: dipping n-type Ge (100) for 30 s in a diluted HF solution at room temperature, then rinsed in deionized water for 30 s
evidence: Before growth, the GeO2 native oxide was removed by dipping n-type Ge (100) for 30 s in a diluted HF solution at room temperature. The Ge substrate was then rinsed in deionized water for 30 s.
